front: (HL) How do you check whether a point lies on a line?
back: Set it equal to $\mathbf a + \lambda\mathbf b$; find $\lambda$ from one component and check that it satisfies the others.

front: (HL) Is the vector equation of a line unique?
back: No — any point on the line and any non-zero multiple of the direction vector give the same line.

front: (HL) Angle between lines with directions $(1, 1, 0)$ and $(1, 0, 1)$?
(HL) Angle between lines: use the position vectors $\mathbf a_1, \mathbf a_2$?
back: No — use the direction vectors $\mathbf b_1, \mathbf b_2$; the absolute value gives the acute angle.

front: (HL) $\mathbf r = \begin{pmatrix}1\\2\end{pmatrix} + t\begin{pmatrix}3\\4\end{pmatrix}$ gives position at time $t$. Initial position and speed?
(HL) Two ships' paths cross. Do they collide?
back: Only if they are at the crossing point at the **same time** — equate positions with the same $t$, not separate parameters.
